units: pixels (image coords, x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static (background median clean; no shift detected)
camera.view: side view of a koi swimming right-to-left parallel to the image plane; plain grey cyclorama (floor curving into back wall), no markings; fish shadow falls on floor near image bottom

objects.name: koi_fish
objects.description: single white/grey koi with orange-red patches, pinkish head, long pale fins; swims leftward horizontally at constant height (bbox centre y ~642 px)
objects.note_partial: frames 0-3 tail cut by right image edge (x1 = 2559)

reference_points.cx_bbox,cy_bbox: centre of the 2D mask bounding box (best proxy of the object origin / bbox centre; drifts ~ -0.7 px/frame relative to body because the tail/fins extend over the clip)
reference_points.body_x,body_y: rigid trunk texture patch (template match, subpixel) - best for rigid displacement

extent_px_fully_visible.trend: length grows ~589 px (frame 4-12) -> ~643 px (frame 62-71) as the tail fin extends; height constant 290-292 px

objects.name: fish_shadow
objects.description: dark elongated shadow of the fish on the floor, y ~1330-1370 px, follows the fish horizontally (offset to the right by ~40-60 px)
objects.note_partial: frames 0-17 cut by right image edge
objects.reliability: soft penumbra; thin far-right tip is faint so length varies 735-824 px; not the fish

objects.name: backdrop_floor
objects.description: seamless light-grey cyclorama; floor/wall transition not sharp; brightest centre-bottom, dark vignette top corners. No measurable static objects.

events.event: body step peaks ~24 px/frame (mild speed-up then back to ~22.3)
